prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance and caused negative impacts across tests.
Adoption copy changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence is still thin for home, new_flow changes as there is only 1 test so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish, notification changes as there is only 1 test so far.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path, redesign, finish, layout, and home, wait_info changes as each has only 1 test so far.
Predictions were generally too high across almost all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -1.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -8.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -10.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_stage_layout: Redesign the choose_path screen into a stage layout featuring animated mascot highlights to help users quickly pick their onboarding path. (why: The choose_path step has a high mean duration of 514s and a 23.8% drop-off, indicating users freeze when deciding.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] pick_friend_personality_quiz: Introduce a pet personality preference questionnaire on pick_friend using choice cards to help users select their ideal companion. (why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% with a mean duration over 1000s, suggesting hesitation during pet selection.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] sign_in_spotlight_reassurance: Redesign sign_in screen to a spotlight layout focusing on cloud sync assurances to guarantee pets are saved. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_diagnostic_checklist: Add a diagnostic checklist component on the waiting screen showing desktop rendering readiness checks. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show up on the desktop after onboarding.)
4: [finish, layout] home_intro_checklist_layout: Switch home_intro to a checklist layout showing key onboarding completion tasks. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with an average completion time of nearly 100 minutes.)
5: [choose_path, hint] story_quick_start_hint: Add a quick-start helper text hint on the story screen encouraging fast progression. (why: Choose path takes an average of 514s, showing users spend excessive time contemplating initial steps.)
6: [sign_in, incentive] sign_in_cloud_save_badge: Display an explicit 'Cloud Save Protected' badge on the sign_in screen. (why: Sign in has a 27.1% drop-off rate and 8 users suffered account/pet loss confusion.)
7: [adoption, copy] adoption_certificate_fallback_notice: Update adoption certificate copy to reassure users that default pet assets will apply if photo generation fails. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual bugs.)
8: [home, notification] waiting_sound_notification: Enable notify_when_ready and add a pleasant audio chime when pet generation finishes. (why: Home wait time averages 2336s, indicating users tab away and forget to return when their pet is ready.)

scores.note: choose_path redesign previously dropped conversion by -8.9% and requires new screens.
Adoption has high drop-off (39.1%), but creating a full personality quiz requires new screens.
Both funnel (27.1% drop-off) and 8 support emails highlight missing pet reassurance, though redesign carries cost.
Supported by support tickets and funnel wait time; home wait_info previously saw +2.5% lift.
Finish step has high drop-off, but finish layout changes previously yielded -0.9% lift.
Low cost helper hint to reduce high mean duration (514s) on choose_path.
High evidence from funnel and 8 support emails with low implementation cost (badge).
Addresses 3 support tickets, but previous adoption copy changes showed no clear positive effect.
Helps users who tab away during long home wait time (2336s); notifications showed slight positive lift prior.
